cohort: The study included data on 22,763 singleton, term, live deliveries that occurred between 2003 and 2014 from the Icelandic Maternal and Child Health Study (ICE-MCH).
finding: Women who are obese before pregnancy have a high risk of caesarean section regardless of gestational weight gain.
mod_finding: Obese women had a higher risk of pre-labour and intrapartum caesarean section, and gestational weight gain above recommended range also increased intrapartum caesarean section risk among normal weight and overweight women.
